item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hi there! Welcome to your weather report for Tuesday, November 3. It's Tuesday, and the week is getting going. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be covered in clouds. It will reach 20 degrees, and drop down to 13 degrees. It should feel pleasantly mild. There is a 18 percent chance of rain. Here's something to notice: today is almost exactly as warm as yesterday. Two days the same in a row! Grey skies are still good for the park. Bring your ball! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be sunny with a few showers, with a high of 19 degrees. Have you thought any more about animals getting ready for winter? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
